role: @Observable holder of streaming-mode and pause/resume state split out of RRCollector so views observing it do not re-render on unrelated collector changes, and of the one-caller claim on ending an overnight session; injected into the SwiftUI environment and read by Record views.
types: StreamingLifecycle.OvernightEndingClaim: struct (Equatable) — one numbered claim on ending the overnight session, with the time it was taken
StreamingLifecycle.EndingClearance: enum (Equatable) — what a starting night found of an earlier ending: clear, a stale claim dropped (with its age), or an ending in progress
state: StreamingLifecycle.staleEndingClaimAge (static, 30 min): how old a claim must be before a starting night may drop it
toplevel: Seven observable stored properties with default initialisers, plus overnightEndingClaim (private(set)) and the claim counter, changed only through claimOvernightEnding(now:) / releaseOvernightEnding(_:) / clearEndingForNewNight(now:) by the overnight Stop, Pause and Discard and a starting night; and the 30-minute staleEndingClaimAge. Owned by RRCollector (RRCollector.swift, created at 703) and read through @Environment(StreamingLifecycle.self) in RecordView and passed to StreamingLiveView/RecordingStatusViews/RecordPanels.

units.does: True while an ending claim is held (overnightEndingClaim non-nil).

Claims the ending of the overnight session for the caller: nil when no night is streaming or a claim is already held; otherwise issues a new numbered OvernightEndingClaim stamped with `now` (default the current time), holds it in overnightEndingClaim and returns it.

branches.cond: not overnight streaming, or a claim already held

units.does: Ends a claimed ending: clears overnightEndingClaim only when the given claim is the one held; a claim already released or dropped changes nothing.

branches.cond: the given claim is not the one held

units.does: For a night or resumed segment that is starting: .clear when no claim is held; .endingInProgress, leaving the claim held, when the held claim is younger than staleEndingClaimAge (30 min); otherwise drops the claim and returns .droppedStale with its age in seconds.
